other_conditions: Student must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi)
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the previous year
Must have an offer letter from a foreign university
Loan is provided only on mortgage of property (building/land) whose value is not less than the loan amount
Student must not have received a scholarship from the Directorate of Minorities
benefits_summary: Loan up to ₹20,00,000 at zero interest rate.
